Introduction:
This dataset describes user-input numbat observations in Australia. Some important variables include the date as well as columns for the year, month, and weekday separately, the dryandra condition, which specifies if it occurred in or out of the national park, and the lat/lon of the observation. My research question is: How have numbat sightings changed over time and between weekdays, and does this vary outside of the Dryandra Woodland NP?

Analysis:
```{r}
#data 
library(tidyverse)
library(ggplot2)

numbats_full <- read_csv("numbats.csv")
numbats <- numbats_full %>%
  filter(is.na(decimalLatitude)==FALSE, is.na(eventDate)==FALSE) %>% #if there's no location or date AXE IT 
  select(decimalLatitude, decimalLongitude, recordID, year, month, wday, hour, dryandra) #stuff i'm interested in

#obs count by year, separated by dryandra 
numstats_year <- numbats %>%
  #filter(dryandra==FALSE) %>%
  group_by(year, dryandra) %>%
  summarise(count = n())

#obs count by weekday, separated by dryandra 
numstats_wday <- numbats %>%
  #filter(dryandra=TRUE) %>%
  group_by(wday, dryandra) %>%
  summarise(count = n())

```

```{r}
#plot - observations per year over time, separated by location
#I omitted 4 observations pre-2000 for plotting purposes 
ggplot(numstats_year, aes(x=year,y=count, color=dryandra)) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 3) + 
  scale_x_continuous(
    breaks = seq(2000, 2025, by = 5),
    limits = c(2000, 2025)) +
    labs(title="Numbat Observations Post-2000, Inside/Outside Dryandra Woodland NP", x = "Year", y="Observation Count") +
  scale_color_manual(
    name = "Location in AUS",   values = c("TRUE" = "purple", "FALSE" = "grey55"),
    labels = c("TRUE" = "Inside Dryandra NP", "FALSE" = "Outside")) + 
  theme_minimal()

```

```{r}
#plot - obs by day of week, separated by location
ggplot(numstats_wday, aes(x = wday, y = count, fill = dryandra)) +
  geom_col() +
  scale_x_discrete(limits = c("Mon", "Tue", "Wed", "Thu", "Fri", "Sat", "Sun")) +
  labs(
    title = "Numbat Observations by Weekday",
    x = "Day of Week",
    y = "Observation Count"
  ) + 
  scale_fill_manual(
  name = "Location in AUS",   values = c("TRUE" = "purple", "FALSE" = "grey55"),
  labels = c("TRUE" = "Inside Dryandra NP", "FALSE" = "Outside")) + 
  theme_minimal()

```
Discussion:
(Regarding line plot) There looks to be an increasing trend in observations outside Dryandra, with notable low and high outliers in 2014 and 2015 respectively. To analyze, I would put in a trendline and assess if the trend is significant. I would also calculate the difference between outside and in and quantify that change. 

(Bar chart) Cool pattern. Less weekend observations (relative to the weekday obs) outside in the wild, but slightly more weekend observations (relative to the rest of inside obs) inside the national park. The latter makes sense as visitors probably go to the NP when they're off work. I'd look further into the difference between weekdays and weekends and assess significance between the two as well as inside vs outside.
